coherence_findings.issue: Twelve members still carry last_tested and last_gotcha (e.g. Shop/D3.js.md:8-9, Shop/Manim CE.md:8-9). SCHEMA — Reference.md:81 says they are not schema fields, nothing writes them, and each comes off when its page grows a tuning ledger. No member in the family has a tuning ledger yet, so the fields are frozen at 2026-05/06 and read as dormancy that is not real (Stable Audio Open's last_gotcha says 2026-09-25 while its last_tested says 2026-05-26). FLUX's last_gotcha (Shop/FLUX (Hugging Face).md:10) holds a whole sentence, which is a gotcha, not a date.
coherence_findings.proposed_action: Drop the two fields from FLUX now (the sentence is already the 2026-05-30 gotcha at FLUX:~150). For the rest, drop them as each page gets its tuning ledger (see memory_needs: Manim CE, ffmpeg, Stable Audio Open, Web Audio Worklet, D3.js, Observable Plot first). Do not add them to AuK or CAD Drafter (neither carries them; good).

coherence_findings.issue: Two dollar figures sit on pages despite the standing no-money rule (MEMORY.md, 2026-10-22: no dollars ever). Shop/FLUX (Hugging Face).md:187 'paid (~$0.025-$0.05 per image)'; Shop/Frame Designer.md:117 'leaked 11 pods before a post-run guard caught it (~$0.6)'. FLUX also frames its whole origin as cost (FLUX:33 'Midjourney's subscription as too expensive'; FLUX:151 'credit-bound runs'; FLUX:62 'No Discord, no --sref codes').
coherence_findings.proposed_action: Strike the two figures (the lessons stand without them: 'paid route, faster cold start'; 'a naive retry leaked 11 pods'). Reduce the Midjourney framing to one clause or delete it (see lighter_prose). No dollar signs anywhere in either page.

coherence_findings.issue: Six members each defer a house scaffold 'to the first real job': Mermaid base themeVariables / --cssFile wrapper (Mermaid:115, and its frontmatter hunger), Remotion base project (Remotion:135), Tone.js artifact template (Tone:142), Web Audio Worklet base scaffold (WAW:173), ffmpeg command templates (ffmpeg:217), SAO seed-pinned reference library (SAO:165). summary: The 18-page Shop half is coherent in its core (Maker, member-of, tiers, test plans) and drifting at the edges. Strongest findings: (1) the link web is over-wired and under-reasoned: D3 and Plot carry the same pair five times, WAW names The Shop twice, five pairs are held from both sides, and 'pairs-with' labels say nothing; keeping one link per pair, with Plot to D3 retyped to deepens[built-on], cuts about fifteen links and loses no reason; AuK's two couples-with claims and CAD Drafter's Blender couples-with are stronger than their bodies support. (2) House-standard drift: twelve pages still carry last_tested and last_gotcha that SCHEMA — Reference.md:81 says leave when a tuning ledger arrives, and none has one; FLUX and Frame Designer carry dollar figures; LaMa and SAM are alive without tiers, self-check or test plans; CAD Drafter lacks a hero. (3) Roster gaps a family reader sees: Tone.js never routes custom DSP to Web Audio Worklet; Frame Designer never names Lettering; ffmpeg's Recipes lack the mux command that lives in Manim; six pages each defer their own house scaffold; four pages each carry the same licence question; Frame Designer and Lettering both want a visual judge; SAM's recipe asks for FLUX with ControlNet, which the FLUX page says it cannot do; FLUX itself is a generation stale (Shopkeeper draft waiting). (4) Lighter prose: stale body Forward Vector sections on six May pages, struck-through and migration histories, repeated Test Suite boilerplate and provenance headers. One genuine new link: Image-to-3D Smith contradicts CAD Drafter (measured vs inferred), which also reaches a newcomer. I found no honest inbound for AuK, Operator Memory, CHILD, or Can an Instrument Notice Where the Work Stops? from this room, and no merge or compost; every thin member is a young stub or has a real operating model. Not settled: whether SA3's limits changed, which ControlNet route the SAM convert-first run used, whether feature/blueline-m3 has merged, and whether Tone and Worklet belong under medium sound.
